tables: An encrypted representation of the model's internal reasoning state. Always present, even when the model performs minimal reasoning.

An array of content (text and/or images) summarizing the reasoning. May be empty depending on the thinking_summaries config, whether the model performed enough reasoning, or the content type (for example, image latents may not have text summaries).
One or more deltas with incremental summary
Cost- and latency-sensitive workloads, such as fast chat and high-throughput processing. Still capable on agentic tasks.
Interactive coding, live UI prototyping, responsive chat, and latency-sensitive tool calls. (Default on gemini-4-carbon, gemini-4-argon, gemini-3.8-flash, and gemini-3.6-flash.)

Recommended default on gemini-4-hydrogen for most tasks, including complex coding, agentic execution, tool calling, and multimodal knowledge work. Maximum reasoning depth on gemini-4-carbon, gemini-4-argon, and Gemini 3 models.
Reserve for hard, multi-step coding and agentic problems where high falls short, when you can trade higher latency and token use (supported on gemini-4-hydrogen).

Matches a near-off setting for most queries on gemini-3.6-flash, gemini-3.5-flash-lite (default), gemini-3.1-flash-lite, gemini-3-flash-preview, and gemini-robotics-er-2-preview. Not supported on Gemini 4 models or gemini-3.8-flash.
